fields.description: Program Description 1. Course Introduction Editor Notes: This program fosters engineering and technical talents suiting the world aviation industry development needs. Students gain the following knowledge and ability: Comprehensive professional education of aircraft design and maintenance; Master the technologies and theory of related fields, including mechanics, materials science, electronics, measurement and control, market economy and other basic knowledge; Professional knowledge of broad aircraft design and maintenance and have comprehensive ability and engineering innovation capabilities. 2. Main Subjects and Courses Editor Notes: There are two main subjects -- basic medicine and clinical medicine as well as 16 main courses for the program: Semester 1: Engineering Graphics 1, Linear Algebra 1, Algebra & Trigonometry 1, Programming in C Language 1, Orientation Program 1, Basic Chinese Speaking 1, Comprehensive Chinese(1) 1, An Introduction to China 1, Physical Education 1-7 Semester 2: An Introduction to Aeronautics, Calculus for Engineering Sciences (1), Physics (1), Physics Experiments (1), Basic Chinese Listening, Comprehensive Chinese (2), Chinese Culture 2, Calculus for Engineering Sciences (2), Essential English Writing Semester 3: Physics Experiments (2) 3, Physics (2), Comprehensive Chinese (3), Academic English Writing, Engineering Training, Engineering Economics, Reading in Chinese, Communication in Chinese, Information Retrieval & Utilization Semester 4: Numerical Analysis, Mathematics Foundation for Information System, Electronic Circuit, Engineering Electromagnetic Field, Digital Circuit, Course Project: Electrical & Electronic Technique, Electronic Circuit Experiment, Principles of Communication, FPGA and its Applications, Probability & Statistics, Matlab Applications, Intermediate Chinese Semester 5: Control System Engineering, Electric Machinery, Analogue Electronics, Microwave Technique and Antenna, Signals and Systems, An Introduction to Industrial Engineering , Project Management, Chinese-to-English Translation, Software Engineering, Random Signal Analysis Semester 6: Power Electronics Technology, Electric Power Engineering, Principles of Micro-computer, Linear Control Systems, Positioning and Navigation System, Principles and Applications of DSP, Digital Image Processing, Speech Signal Processing, Basic Writing in Chinese 6 Semester 7: Modern Testing Technology, Digital Signal Processing, Modern Control Theory, Flight Control System, Digital Control System: Theory and Design, Aerospace Power Supply System, Digital Control in Power Electronics, Spread Spectrum Communication, Professional Ethics, Multi-media Technology & Applications Semester 8: Graduation Project 3. Future Career Fields After Graduation​ Editor Notes: The prospect of employment looks very promising. Aircraft Production and Design Industries Robotics and Mechanical Engineering Industries Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), Drones Air and Space-based telecommunication industries Aircraft Maintainance Industries Further Research Military Service and other related technology-intensive fields 4. Accreditation Editor Notes: Accredited by the Ministry of Education, China. NUAA's degree is accepted worldwide. NUAA's International Link: NUAA's degree allows you to take your project in China, your home country or a third country. NUAA has partnered with top universities in the USA, Australia, and EU where some students take their third or fourth year of study. Career Prospects: NUAA recent graduates have been employed by organizations such as: 5. Brief Introduction to Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics Editor Notes: NUAA is now a comprehensive university especially featured with Aerospace Engineering. Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics(NUAA), established in 1952, enjoys a well-balanced development of multiple disciplines in natural sciences, humanities, social sciences, management, etc. with the characteristics of aeronautics, astronautics and civil aviation. NUAA is among the first batch of national key universities entitled to award doctoral degree, master's degree and bachelor's degree. It is one of the 52 universities with graduate school in China, and it has also been listed in the "National Project 211" as one of the 100 key universities for the 21st century. Presently, NUAA has established international cooperation and exchange with more than 60 universities and institutions all over the world. Learn More about Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics 6. About IEC Editor Notes: IEC has carried out a wide range of multi-level and diversified international cooperation education. The earliest institution in Jiangsu Province to set up Sino-foreign cooperatively-run schools. The aim is to cultivate an international higher vocational college with international vision and complementary advanced cultures between the East and the West. Carried out exchange student programs with high-level universities in the United States, Britain, France, Australia, Sweden and Ukraine. Joint training programs have been carried out with universities in Britain and Australia, and recruited students from nearly 20 countries. Rapid development of school-running scale and the continuous improvement of school-running quality is distinctive international education characteristics.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 2. Non-Criminal letter * 3. Two letters of recommendation from high school teachers, with signature and contact * 4. Financial Guarantee Letter or bank statement * 5. English language proficiency certificate Certificate Letter that English is the learning language during study duration, or English scores in senior high school, or copy of the official IELTS certificate TOFEL certificate. * 6. Photocopy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Original or notarized copy of transcripts for all the courses in senior high school. Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 8. Personal statement (no more than 800 words), including personal introduction, reasons for application and individual advantages * 9. Resume Written in Chinese or in English * 10. Original or notarized copy of senior high school diploma Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. Applicants who will graduate can provide pre-graduation certificate instead. The original or notarized diploma shall be submitted upon registration. * 11. Scanned copy of passport front page(and valid China visa page if you are already in China) * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -CSCA test is mandatory for every application. The test score should be supplemented Before May 30, 2026. Engineering programs: Mathematics and Physics, both in English. Business program: Mathematics, in English. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Non-Chinese citizens 2.17-25 years old (Applicants under 18 should provide certificate of guardian who has Nanjing residency.) 3.Senior-high graduates or above 4.English-taught program: IELTS (6.0 or above), TOEFL (80 or above) or equivalent English proficiency letter. 5.CSCA subjects requirements: Engineering programs: Mathematics and Physics, both in English. Business program: Mathematics, in English.
